command:
set -eu
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- identity ---'
id
printf '%s\n' '--- os-release ---'
cat /etc/os-release
printf '%s\n' '--- kernel ---'
uname -a
printf '%s\n' '--- init/package/logging ---'
printf 'init='; ps -p 1 -o comm=
printf 'pkgmgr='; command -v dnf || command -v yum || command -v rpm || true
rpm -q sudo rsyslog 2>&1 || true
sudo -V | sed -n '1,12p'
printf '%s\n' '--- services ---'
systemctl is-active rsyslog 2>&1 || true
systemctl is-enabled rsyslog 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- relevant sudo/syslog config ---'
ls -ld /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d /var/log
stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d /var/log
sha256sum /etc/sudoers /etc/rsyslog.conf
find /etc/sudoers.d /etc/rsyslog.d -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%p\n' | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- sudo logging directives ---'
grep -RniE '^[[:space:]]*(Defaults.*(syslog|logfile|log_input|log_output)|[^#].*sudo)' /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- failures/listeners/access ---'
systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager || true
ss -lntup
sudo -n true && echo SUDO_NONINTERACTIVE_OK
printf '%s\n' '--- boot identity ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id

start=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
ok=ANTRIEB_SUDO_ALLOWED_20261004T1842Z

printf '%s\n' '--- allowed sudo invocation ---'
sudo -n /usr/bin/printf '%s\n' "$ok"
printf '%s\n' '--- denied sudo invocation as existing unprivileged identity ---'
set +e
runuser -u nobody -- sudo -n /usr/bin/printf '%s\n' "$denied"
rc=$?
set -e
printf 'denied_rc=%s\n' "$rc"
sleep 1
printf '%s\n' '--- dedicated sudo log proof ---'
grep -E "$ok|$denied" /var/log/sudo-commands.log
printf '%s\n' '--- journal exclusion proof ---'
if journalctl --since "$start" --no-pager -o short-iso | grep -E "$ok|$denied"; then
  echo UNEXPECTED_MARKER_IN_JOURNAL
  exit 1
else
  echo NO_TEST_MARKERS_IN_JOURNAL
fi
printf '%s\n' '--- general log-file exclusion proof ---'
if grep -H -E "$ok|$denied" /var/log/messages /var/log/secure 2>/dev/null; then
  echo UNEXPECTED_MARKER_IN_GENERAL_LOG
  exit 1
else
  echo NO_TEST_MARKERS_IN_MESSAGES_OR_SECURE
fi
printf '%s\n' '--- log metadata after write ---'
stat -c '%a %U:%G %s %n' /var/log/sudo-commands.log
ls -lZ /var/log/sudo-commands.log
